subject: Avoid compilation error oin valkey-cli (#721)
reason: The change only adds an unreachable `return 0;` after an `assert(0)` in clusterManagerNodePrimaryRandom() in valkey-cli.c to fix a compilation warning/error about control reaching the end of a non-void function. The added statement can never execute at runtime, so no behavior of valkey-cli or the server changes; it is a build fix that needs no scenario.
